Another bipartisan bill pretending to "protect families" while expanding government control over healthcare. The Supporting Healthy Moms and Babies Act forces insurers to eliminate cost-sharing - a Trojan horse for centralized medical decision-making. Premiums will spike as bureaucrats dictate coverage terms, not patients.

True reform would empower families through expanded health savings accounts and tax credits for direct care payments. Instead, this entrenches insurance monopolies while pretending to help parents. Medicaid already covers 41% of births - this just drags more Americans into the broken system.

Real choice comes from market freedom, not D.C. mandates. Let parents keep their money through Fair Tax reforms rather than laundering it through corporate-insurer partnerships.
